title: RestoreRequestPrincipal
description: The RestoreRequest a Factory emits after stamping the verified sender. Same record and decoder as restore_request; this pair pins the principal-carrying shape.

id.description: Opaque UTF-8 identity; Core enforces the 256-byte limit.

principal.description: The verified sender a Factory stamped after credential verification. Never client-supplied: a Factory refuses a request that carries it.
